newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar stock index breaks into new higher ground.
newsitem.headline: Qatar stock index breaks into new higher ground.

text.p: The index on Qatar's unofficial stock market for the first time broke through the 120 point mark in the week to Thursday, led by strong performances in the banking and insurance sectors, brokers said.

The 18-share Commercial Bank of Qatar index ended at 120.01 points from 119.08 led by gains in Commercial Bank of Qatar (CBQ) and Qatar Insurance Co (QIC). CBQ rose six riyals to 332 and QIC gained five riyals to 680.
"The index has in fact gone up by more than five percent during the current month of September and the prospects are for further increases," the CBQ said.
Seven shares rose and 11 were unchanged in the week.
Qatar National Navigation and Transport Co increased two riyals to 687.
Doha Bank Ltd, Qatar Islamic Bank, Qatar Shipping Co and Qatar National Cement each rose one riyal to 266, 122, 47 and 290 riyals respectively.
